raw:
Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 7
, Reason for Mistake: Misinterpreted the lineage from the 3rd Earl’s page—because the 3rd Earl was the grandson of the 1st Earl, the Planner incorrectly concluded the 1st Earl was the 4th Earl’s paternal grandfather, overlooking that the 4th Earl’s father is the 3rd Earl, making the 2nd Earl the correct paternal grandfather.
